B.1.scope_append: The new limit diagnostics refute two shortcuts involving continuous-cohomology colimits and completed Frobenius modules; they do not prove the required uniform ramification control. On the specified two-boundary open in P4, the comparison cokernel is exactly im(G) intersect ker(cl) on its threefold components. This fixed-open formula neither proves vanishing nor proves survival under further shrinking. The ordinary Milnor regulator has exactly the infinitely ell-divisible kernel in every degree; the residue criterion holds in positive degree. This uses the diagonal twist and does not remove the weight-zero part of the degree-three/twist-two residue gate. The separated ordinary Milnor quotient is countably free and has the same completion. A fully explicit free submodule of a sum of finite permutation lattices nevertheless acquires eigenvalue4 after3-adic completion, so freeness does not control the missing completed eigenclasses. The separated quotient is in fact canonical and common to every coefficient prime different from p: divisibility maps trivially into any of the proved free quotients. The same formal integral module can nevertheless have a completed eigenvalue at3 and none at any other prime, so the common quotient does not resolve the required comparison.

B.5.scope_append: For the specified rational Weil extension of all Chow-heart coefficients, perfect duality is equivalent to Beilinson plus Parshin and is already detected on P1 with constant coefficients. This stronger coefficient scope is distinguished from homogeneous pure summands; it does not resolve arithmetic f-admissibility.

C.4.scope_append: Positivity on the surface-square target together with homological=numerical equivalence on the mixed threefold-surface product is a proved sufficient package. Its unresolved product hypotheses do not prove the residual pairing. The universal middle-degree trait endpoint is equivalent to weight–monodromy; an individual j-fold has a finite exterior-power test with r<=j+1. Both universal assertions remain unresolved, and the arbitrary-morphism transfer is separately scoped. A globally squarefree primitive target Frobenius polynomial replaces the target Hodge-positivity hypothesis in a proved sufficient subcase, with mixed numerical=homological equivalence retained. No universal transfer supplies these conditions. The additional transfer attempt proves that constant-field extensions, smooth projective surface alterations and nonzero Artin-factor twists cannot remove a repeated primitive Frobenius root. This is a limitation of those transfers to the sufficient squarefree case, not a theorem excluding every possible geometric transfer.

C.6.scope_append: Finite-prime local/global approximation proves equivalence of the universal number-field and p-adic pure-motive formulations. A finite-field cycle still lacks the pure local realization needed for the attempted converse; occurrence among semistable strata is insufficient. The inspected conductor formulas do not supply the missing ordinary inertia-invariant dimension: their additive derived-inertia scalar trace ignores the nilpotent rank even after a supplied homogeneous projector.
